news.title: trunk/b74c3864e80a297ab81441720f8215970ae049e4: [dynamo] Support bytearray.append() and extend() (#199675)
news.dek:
ByteArrayVariable had no append/extend, so calling either on a bytearray 
graph broke. This adds both to tp_methods. 
 Both follow the existing in-place ops on ByteArrayVariable (+=, *=, %=): 
build the result in a new buffer, record the mutation with side_effects, 
and swap self
news.aiSummary: ByteArrayVariable previously lacked append and extend methods, causing failures when used in bytearray graphs. The patch adds these methods to tp_methods, mirroring existing in-place operations by creating a new buffer, recording the mutation with side_effects, and swapping the original object.
